svg.title: Four panels: a square with a smaller square removed; two directed paths from a point x to a point x' going up-and-right around the hole on either side; the points 0, p, q, 1 at the corners of the square and of the hole, with directed paths from p to q on both sides of the hole; and the category E given by 0 to p, two arrows from p to q, and q to 1.
